policy: RESIDENTIAL DWELLING INSURANCE / Policy wording "WD-2026" - Electrical and Electronic Equipment Edition
description: During a thunderstorm, a power surge came through the wiring and damaged a speaker system and a TV set that were plugged in at the time. A technician was called out afterwards to check the electronics and confirm the wiring itself was safe.
